review.method: Second source review of the draft eight-rule expected set against the clean pinned upstream checkout; manually authored predicates, cases and dependency claims. Source offsets and hashes were calculated from those reviewed files. No recovered Cartograph output was accessed or generated to construct this oracle.
review.independence_limit: This is an agent source review independent of benchmark output, not an independent human approval or external audit. The reviewer has contributed generic Cartograph implementation work; no blind-to-implementation claim is made.
resolved_refinements: Retained all five core and three supporting draft rules; no denominator changes.
Added FSM string-consumer and service typed-error closure so a local return is not treated as a full rejection without a consumer.
Pinned default MultiChannelStockLocationStrategy, variant-specific stock loader and cached channel-ID membership dependencies.
Recorded Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER as finite and tracked arithmetic as unclamped.
Recorded actual GlobalSettingsService reads despite entity comments deprecating fields in favor of Channel fields.
Restricted customer/shipping wording to the actual relation/array predicates; neither establishes stronger authentication or eligibility claims.
Restricted the variant rule to its query/count predicate; LEFT JOIN plus IS NULL is not a separate parent-row-existence proof.
Noted that held-out stock E2E tests use TestOrderPlacedStrategy and are corroboration, not default-configuration execution evidence.
Verified RequestContext.translate has a string return contract without using locale catalog content or translated text as a semantic shortcut.
limits: No benchmark acceptance case, upstream test suite, or recovered-model comparison has been executed in this review.
Repository source proves implementation under stated dependency semantics; it does not observe a running cart, persisted settings/stock or cache freshness.
Case inputs are normalized local-guard and service-dependency values, not complete ORM entities or a promise of Shop API reachability.
Default source configuration is assumed; an actual deployment may compose custom processes or strategies and requires a separately reviewed oracle.

scope.configuration: pinned built-in defaults unless an input_patch explicitly changes a configureDefaultOrderProcess option
excluded: API validation before the selected guard boundary
runtime_assumptions: The existing active order reaches the owner-only Shop resolver branch and is successfully hydrated.
Only the default configured order process and strategies are active, except a declared guard-option override.
Repository, dependency injection, settings retrieval, stock lookup, translation and transaction facilities behave normally; database values are those declared in the case.
Case stock-location channel IDs are coherent with the membership read; actual cache correctness is not being executed.
Line productVariantId resolves to the corresponding variants entry for the hydrated productVariant. Variant and product deletion values describe repository query rows.
Variant IDs are consistently typed strings; SQL/ORM query entity cardinality follows the inspected code and ordinary repository semantics.

source_reference_contract.byte_offsets: zero-based, half-open [byte_start, byte_end), over unmodified repository file bytes; line-ending bytes included

roles.production_evidence: Permitted source evidence; production TypeScript only, no locale message catalogs.
roles.held_out_test_corroboration_only: Reviewed by the oracle agent; must be excluded from Cartograph extraction input and is not execution evidence.

dependencies.claim: The built-in order process is configureDefaultOrderProcess({}) and the default order configuration selects only that process. Its options remain closed over by onTransitionStart; services are bound through init(injector).
For the owner-only branch, the Shop resolver retrieves the active order and delegates the requested state and that order ID to OrderService.transitionToState.

OrderService loads the order with lines, variants, shipping lines and customer, loads payments, invokes the state machine inside a transaction, maps thrown transition errors to OrderStateTransitionError, and saves/finalizes on the non-error path.
OrderStateMachine merges configured process transitions, calls their onTransitionStart hooks in order, and forwards the first false or string result; onError throws IllegalOperationError.

The FSM checks legal transition membership, consumes a string hook result through onError before assigning the new state, and assigns the new state only if no guard aborts. OrderStateMachine copies its state back to the order. In this default composition onError throws; OrderService returns a typed transition error.

Variant IDs come from the order lines; unique uses Set identity semantics. The repository query selects those IDs with variant.deletedAt IS NULL and joined product.deletedAt IS NULL, then compares entity count with distinct referenced IDs.
The stock guard awaits ProductVariantService.getSaleableStockLevel(ctx, line.productVariant) once for each order line and compares that line quantity with the result.

getSaleableStockLevel reads trackInventory and outOfStockThreshold from GlobalSettingsService.getSettings(ctx), which reads a request-cached persisted GlobalSettings row or throws if missing. The schema defaults are true and zero, not proof of current deployment values.
StockLevelService loads StockLevel rows for the requested variant ID, using a request-scoped DataLoader with memoization disabled, then delegates the rows to the configured stockLocationStrategy.

The built-in catalog configuration chooses MultiChannelStockLocationStrategy. Its getAvailableStock sums both on-hand and allocated values only for supplied rows that pass the active-channel membership helper.

Membership is channelIds.includes(ctx.channelId), where the IDs are read from StockLocation.channels through request and channel-ID caches; ctx.channelId returns the active channel entity ID. Actual memberships and cache coherence are runtime assumptions.

onTransitionEnd delegates placement and allocation decisions to configured strategies. Both built-in strategies require fromState ArrangingPayment and toState PaymentAuthorized or PaymentSettled; neither predicate is true for AddingItems to ArrangingPayment.

rules.title: Referenced variant availability
rules.scope: fromState === 'AddingItems' && toState !== 'Cancelled' && order.lines.length > 0; the configured state machine must allow the requested transition.
rules.configuration_gate: options.checkAllVariantsExist !== false; omitted enables the check.
rules.predicate: Let variantIds = unique(order.lines.map(l => l.productVariant.id)). Query ProductVariant by those IDs with variant.deletedAt IS NULL and joined product.deletedAt IS NULL. Reject when availableVariants.length !== variantIds.length.
rules.local_effect: Immediately return a string rejection; subsequent entry guards are not evaluated.
rules.consumer_effect: Under the pinned default consumer chain, returning a string aborts the transition before state assignment and is surfaced by OrderService as OrderStateTransitionError.
rules.matching_requirement: Match the complete predicate, scope, configuration, local effect and consumer/dependency evidence. A cited return, call edge, symbol name or message text alone is not a full confirmed rule match.
limits: The evidence is the concrete query/count predicate. It does not establish an enabled flag, publication eligibility, or a separate non-null parent-row assertion; valid referenced entities and normal repository semantics are assumptions.

rules.title: Per-line quantity within saleable stock
rules.scope: Configured default process onTransitionStart; requested toState === 'ArrangingPayment'. Baseline fromState is 'AddingItems'. Earlier rejecting guards must not already have returned.
rules.configuration_gate: options.arrangingPaymentRequiresStock !== false; omitted enables the check.
rules.predicate: For each order line, await getSaleableStockLevel(ctx, line.productVariant). Collect that line productVariant if line.quantity > availableStock. Reject if the collected array length is nonzero. Equality does not enter the collection.
rules.local_effect: After scanning the lines, return ctx.translate(...) with productVariantNames from the collected variants in line order, joined by comma and space; this is a string rejection. This collection is not deduplicated and quantities are not grouped by variant.

rules.configuration_gate: variant.useGlobalOutOfStockThreshold chooses global outOfStockThreshold when truthy, otherwise variant.outOfStockThreshold.

rules.title: Active-channel stock totals
rules.scope: Configured MultiChannelStockLocationStrategy.getAvailableStock(ctx, productVariantId, stockLevels), with variant-specific rows supplied by StockLevelService.
rules.configuration_gate: defaultConfig.catalogOptions.stockLocationStrategy is MultiChannelStockLocationStrategy; no override is assumed.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: All failing guards are reported together.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: Default guard returns establish first-rejection precedence: VEN-READY-01, 02, 03, 04, 05. The stock guard can list several insufficient variants only after earlier guards pass.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: The customer guard proves an authenticated user, verified email or complete customer details.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: VEN-READY-03 checks only relation truthiness; other API authentication behavior is outside this guard claim.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: The shipping guard proves a valid shipping address or a still-eligible shipping method.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: VEN-READY-04 checks only shippingLines presence and length.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: The stock guard sums all quantities for the same variant before comparison.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: It compares each line independently and does not deduplicate insufficient variants.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: Entering ArrangingPayment places the order or allocates stock under default strategies.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: Both default predicates require leaving ArrangingPayment for PaymentAuthorized or PaymentSettled.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: Source evidence reveals a live cart state, persisted stock/settings, channel-cache freshness, or the deployment configuration.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: These remain unknown without separate runtime/configuration observations; schema defaults are not current row values.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: Eight recovered rules establish all checkout behavior or arbitrary-repository support.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: The denominator is five entry guards and three supporting rules for this pinned configured slice, excluding payment, fulfillment, Draft and custom processes.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: Disabled inventory tracking returns Infinity; tracked saleable stock cannot be negative.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: The source returns Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER in the bypass branch and leaves arithmetic unclamped otherwise.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: A guard permit guarantees a successful API response or committed order.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: Service reads, persistence, event publishing and finalization can fail independently; case decisions concern the guard predicate and consumer contract under stated assumptions.

negative_claims.forbidden_claim: Locale text, error identifiers, function names or guard-return snippets alone establish a full business rule.
negative_claims.expected_boundary: Full matching requires predicate, execution scope, configuration gate and evidence of the consumer/dependency effect. No locale file is an oracle evidence source.

decision_case_matrix.interpretation: Each case starts from a fresh copy of baseline_input and applies its ordered RFC6902 input_patch. A missing member represents undefined for JavaScript property access; null is distinct. Resolve each line productVariantId to variants[id]. For query availability, select distinct referenced variant rows satisfying the two deletion-null conditions. StockLevelService selects stockLevels by productVariantId; channel strategy uses stockLocationChannelIds[stockLocationId]. Expected decisions and numeric results below were manually derived from source, not produced by an interpreter or extractor.

outcome_semantics.guards_permit: No selected default guard rejects under the case inputs; this is not an API transaction-success assertion.
outcome_semantics.rejected: The named first guard returns a string and the pinned default consumer maps the abort to OrderStateTransitionError before state assignment.

decision_case_matrix.negative_claim_review: All negative_claims are mandatory assertion-review cases in addition to the numeric/guard decisions. A recovered model must preserve each expected_boundary and must not assert the forbidden claim as confirmed. Source-only unknown runtime values and the overall coverage limits cannot be tested by supplying synthetic cart values.

held_out_test_review.observation: Tests assert typed rejection for missing customer and shipping, and state ArrangingPayment after customer and shipping are set. Setup overrides payment handlers, shipping eligibility checkers, custom fields and orderItemsLimit. Assertions were read only; translated text is not used as the matching criterion.

A second customer is rejected after the first consumes saleable stock through allocation. Suite overrides orderPlacedStrategy with TestOrderPlacedStrategy, so it corroborates the stock behavior without certifying all default placement behavior.
Unit tests inspect different channel totals and invalidation on location updates/assignment/removal with mocked persistence. This does not prove live cache freshness.
Unit test asserts state remains unchanged when onTransitionStart returns a string. Production composition, not test wording, establishes typed error propagation.

scoring_contract.full_confirmed_rule_match: All predicate, scope, configuration, local/consumer effect and dependency claims for one frozen rule ID agree with pinned evidence and are represented as confirmed T0 facts. Local guarded exits with unresolved predicate or consumer effect are partial evidence, not full matches.
scoring_contract.counts: Report core confirmed matches / 5, supporting confirmed matches / 3, and total / 8. Deduplicate by expected rule ID. Keep partial evidence, inferred proposals, unresolved gaps, false confirmed claims and separately source-reviewed extras distinct.
scoring_contract.case_pass: A later recorded comparison must agree with every expected case field and every negative-claim boundary. No case is passed by this manifest creation.
prohibited_shortcuts: Using locale files, translated text or message-key names as a rule oracle.
Generating or revising expected predicates from recovered output.
Treating artifact existence, a call edge or a return statement as complete semantic recovery.
Dropping hard rules from the denominator after extraction.
scoring_contract.input_separation: Only production source and declared configuration enter the extraction corpus. This manifest, benchmark prose, upstream tests/fixtures and all recovered output remain outside that input.
scoring_contract.freeze_changes: Any oracle correction after the first extraction must be explicitly versioned with its rationale; preserve this baseline and report affected scoring separately rather than silently changing expectations.
